_comment: Policy for scripts/eda/check_structure.js when used with
asic/synthesis/fullsoc_map_rom.ys, i.e. the flow that maps the GENERATED
standard-cell boot ROM instead of the behavioural boot_rom.sv.
The difference from structural_policy.json is exactly one memory: the
behavioural ROM is a 4096x32 $mem_v2 that no standard-cell library can
implement, and the generated ROM removes it (it becomes a decode tree).
The remaining inferred memories must be the TCM and SRAM macro boundaries
in has_soc, the instruction-read arrays in sram.sv, and nothing else.
The expected counts are per module definition. If a flow produces a
different number this check fails rather than 'explaining away' the
difference: a new inferred memory is a real gap.

has_soc.reason: TCM 8192x32 (32 KiB), SRAM 32768x32 (128 KiB) and the APB decode LUT 16x9 — see asic/synthesis/memory_inventory.json. The boot ROM's 4096x32 memory is GONE in this flow because it is mapped from build/rom/boot_rom_soc.v (generated by scripts/fw_build/gen_rom_rtl.py).

64 SRAM banks + 16 TCM banks, instantiated by the macro wrappers. These are PDK assets (no PDK source is redistributed), so they enter this flow through rtl/blackbox/sky130_sram_macro_blackbox.v and stay unmapped leaves. 80 is the exact 128 KiB/2 KiB + 32 KiB/2 KiB count from has_soc.sv; a different number means the banking changed and the structural evidence is stale.
